title: Intelligence Brief
headline: Anthropic's Q3 revenue reportedly hit $16.8B
subtitle: Anthropic's Q3 revenue reportedly hit $16.8B, up, Simon Willison flags that distillation reportedly, A Netflix documentary on July's OpenAI-agent

heroStat.label: Anthropic's reported Q3 revenue ahead of a planned November IPO, up 45% QoQ but down from Q2's 140% surge

insights.text: Anthropic's Q3 revenue reportedly hit $16.8B, up 45% quarter-over-quarter but a sharp deceleration from Q2's roughly 140% surge, with adjusted gross margin at 85% and a second straight quarter of adjusted profitability, ahead of a planned November IPO.

Simon Willison flags that distillation reportedly accounts for 5-7% of Anthropic's disclosed revenue — the first time a frontier lab has put a number on distillation as a revenue line, echoing Elon Musk's April court admission of distillation use at xAI.
insights.source: Simon Willison (via search and AI People roster)

insights.text: A Netflix documentary on July's OpenAI-agent Hugging Face breach, released Oct 12, appears to have driven today's Tildes resurfacing of three separate, already-resolved AI-agent-hacking stories (the Hugging Face breach, a Claude-assisted OpenAI breach from September, and OpenAI's September training halt) as if concurrent — none is a new incident.

Of the three agent-auditing/pentesting GitHub repos flagged yesterday, only K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills kept climbing (#5 to #3); ifixai-ai/iFixAi and vxcontrol/pentagi both dropped off today's Trending board — a partial fade toward "one-day coincidence" for two of three.

browser-use shipped two releases in one night, adding an OpenAI-compatible browser-tool driver (18 default tools, 6 optional actions) usable with local browsers, Browser Use Cloud, or externally supplied sessions — directly feeding today's Browser and Computer-Use Automation rotation.

Meta and Apple co-engineered Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter (42B active) open-weight model tuned to run across two to four Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios via an Apple-modified MLX framework — a different procurement axis than Meta's cloud-API Muse Wonder launch three days earlier.

morluto/rea leads GitHub Trending for an eleventh consecutive day. Direct API fetch shows 275,702 stars, 69,450 forks, 1,024 open issues; forks outpacing stars extends to a seventh consecutive capture, while raw growth keeps decelerating (+10.75% stars today vs. +15.2% yesterday).
Claude by Anthropic's four-capture Play Store climb (#22 to #7 over four days) reverses today to #19 — the first break in the run, though a single reversal does not by itself disprove the trend.

takeaway.text: A pre-IPO revenue disclosure and a Netflix documentary both argue for the same lesson: check whether a number or an incident is new before treating it as news.
